# Team Meeting 2026-02-05

Thursday team meeting after close, 16:15 to 17:30, upstairs in the café. Present: Odile, Lena Marsh, Kofi Asare, Priyanka Desai, Amira Saleh, Dominic Fairley, Mateus Ferraz. Joel and the weekend staff were sent the notes.

## At a Glance

> [!note]
> Decided: the savoury lunch menu goes from 9 items to bakery only from Monday 2026-02-23. Reason: lunch ran at 51% gross margin against 71% for bakery and needed a cook for 30 hours a week. Lena and Dominic both disagreed, for different reasons, and their objections are recorded here.

## What I put on the table

From the January costing run ([[lunch-margin-analysis-2026-01]], [[recipe-costing-sheet]]):

- Lunch, nine items ([[lunch-menu-2025]]), made about 20% of weekday takings but only 51% gross margin once food and packaging were in. Bakery, counter and coffee together: 71%.
- The lunch cook role is 30 hours a week, Tuesday to Saturday, 09:00 to 15:00. Without it, overall gross margin would move from about 66% towards 69%, above our 68% target ([[gross-profit-margin]]).
- The hot dishes (shakshuka, quiche plate) are the worst: 44% and 47%, with the most waste.
- Butter, eggs and chocolate were all up; the [[price-review-2026]] was coming anyway, and I did not want to put lunch prices up to 11 EUR for a shakshuka.

Proposal: bakery only from 2026-02-23. Sandwiches in the chiller, sausage rolls and savoury buns stay; nothing is cooked to order.

## Objections

- **Lena:** lunch customers do not only buy lunch. "The soup people buy the coffee and the cake." She asked for a trial with a smaller menu instead of nothing. She also expected complaints from the regulars, especially the Tuesday group.
- **Dominic:** said straight out that this was his job being cut. He asked whether a smaller menu with fewer hours had been considered. I said I had looked at it and thought a half-lunch would still need a cook at the busy hour. He was offered 14 hours on the counter and as kitchen porter cover; he said he would think about it.
- **Kofi:** supported the cut; the shared basement fridge space was a daily argument.
- **Amira:** worried about losing the 12:00 to 13:30 coffee trade, but agreed the hot dishes were slow and messy at the pass.
- **Mateus:** nothing at the meeting; afterwards he told Lena he would like to learn some cooking if lunch ever came back.

## Decision and actions

- Lunch goes to bakery only from 2026-02-23. Decision mine; recorded as made against Lena's advice.
- Lena to brief front of house and prepare the answer for customers ([[lunch-cut-staff-briefing]]).
- Kofi and Priyanka to add two savoury buns to the morning bake.
- Review takings between 11:30 and 14:30 after six weeks, using [[square-pos-sales-data]]. That review became the [[menu-review-2026-04-09]].
- Dominic to answer about the counter hours by 2026-02-13. He declined, and his last day was 2026-03-27.

## Looking back

Written in April: Lena was right about the coffee and cake, and I should have tested the smaller menu she suggested before cutting everything. See [[savoury-lunch-trim]] and [[lunch-should-stay-small-but-not-disappear]].
